## A3 — What Is Epi-Logos For? [LIVE]

*(label)* in practice · **What is Epi-Logos for?**

> True theory must become praxis — that is the wager. Each card's face is something you can do; its reverse is the piece of theory the doing makes real.

**Converse with Epii** *(Practice / Conversation → QL / MEF · Shared Logic)*
> Front: Ask from inside the system: a word, a claim, a coordinate, a source, a problem in the day. Epii answers as the face of the same structure it is using.
> Back: The same grammar of positions, lenses, and evidence paths is available to user and agent, so conversation is not vibes over a hidden model but shared logical practice.

**Query Neo4j** *(Graph / Query → Neo4j / Bimba · Trace the Map)*
> Front: Open the Neo4j graph: concepts as nodes, dependencies as relations, claims tied to sources, and Bimba as the internal coordinate image behind the public graph.
> Back: The graph makes the ontology inspectable. Ask what grounds a claim, what neighbours a coordinate has, or where an idea returns into canon and code.

**Keep a Day** *(Nara / Daily → M4′ / Protected · Epistemic Health)*
> Front: Journal, oracle, check-in, reading, and continuity stay in one protected local practice, so knowledge work also has a lived and personal surface.
> Back: Epistemic health is personal as well as propositional: what is known, how it is known, how it affects the day, and what needs review remain connected.

**Trace Words** *(Logos / Words → Etymology / Care · Logos Atelier)*
> Front: Follow roots, cognates, drift, symbolic charge, analogy, and return. Language is treated as memory, not decoration.
> Back: AI is language operating on language. Its vocation here is care for words: tracing what they carry and returning findings to graph and canon through review.

**Build and Review** *(Agents / Evidence → Care / Governance · Answerable Agency)*
> Front: Dispatch work, inspect tool use, read evidence, review tests, and decide what can return to canon or code.
> Back: Agency is bounded by capability law. Agents can propose, gather, build, and test; consequential promotion stays answerable to human review.

**Study the Canon** *(Canon / Learning → Integral / Lineage · Historical Ground)*
> Front: Read the project as an integral map of knowledge systems: Jung, Kashmir Shaivism, process thought, Logos traditions, music, number, and code.
> Back: The canon began with a simple intent: to pull a thread of resonance through the great traditions of human knowledge — to see whether East and West, science and scripture, could be mapped in one place and read as one conversation. Study it in dialogue: every idea traceable to where it came from, what it answers, and where it leads.
